The poison is treating open-ended public entitlement as an inalienable right, bankrupting local services under the banner of compassion.

The plane error confuses WHO (human dignity) with WHAT (fiscal sustainability of municipal welfare systems), weaponizing empathy to shield policy failures.

Actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using humanitarian pretexts to mask fiscal extraction and projecting blame onto federal enforcers.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. F_pos outweighs F_neg through moral posturing.

The Unavoidable Truth: Compassion without fiscal limits collapses public infrastructure.

The Unavoidable Lie: Unrestricted welfare access is a universal human right.
